## Background

As a Strategic Management student at BYU, I am driven by a passion for business and an eagerness to tackle complex challenges. I am confident that my Problem Solving, Communication, and Collaboration skills are a powerful combination that make me a strong contributor to any team.

## Core Strengths

### Problem Solving

My passion for problem-solving is at the core of my professional drive. During my internship at Bass Pro Shops, I noticed that my manager was spending 15 hours each month manually compiling key performance indicators. Recognizing an opportunity for improvement, I leveraged my technical skills to code an automated solution using VBA and AI. This initiative not only reduced the monthly report generation time from 15 hours to just 5 minutes but also unlocked a new level of business intelligence. The trust I earned from this project led to further data analytics responsibilities, where I was able to automate additional reporting and build new dashboards and charts, providing visibility into employee performance. This experience solidified my ability to identify inefficiencies, solve complex problems with technical solutions, and create tangible value by unlocking new opportunities.

### Collaboration

Purposeful collaboration is the key to solving complex problems and achieving ambitious goals. During my internship at Solase Pickleball, a startup in its pre-launch phase, I was tasked with leading a team of four interns to generate product awareness and social media hype for our first shoe. Despite my limited background in marketing, I built an effective team grounded in principles of mutual respect and high standards. We set an ambitious goal of increasing our social media following by 500%. By fostering a culture of honest and direct feedback, we consistently tested new ideas, which turned our initial slow growth into a pivotal surge of followers. By the end of my internship, we had successfully grown our Instagram following from 300 to 1,500, and, post-launch, this result contributed to the company selling 1–3 shoes organically every single day. This experience strengthened my capacity for collaborative leadership, demonstrating my ability to drive team performance through honest feedback and high goals.

### Communication

Without clear communication, even the most innovative solutions can fail to gain traction. At Bass Pro Shops, my team was tasked with a website redesign project that would culminate in a presentation to a panel of 30 senior leaders. Our analysis revealed a significant opportunity to increase organic website traffic through improved SEO. To ensure this complex argument resonated with executives, I applied the Pyramid Principle, leading with our core recommendation and supporting it with synthesized data and easily digestible visuals. Following the presentation, our work received praise from multiple senior leaders for its clear message. Also, during my time as a volunteer representative for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, I frequently gave presentations to groups of 70–100+ individuals, where I focused on mastering delivery, leveraging vocal variety, and purposeful body language. These experiences have honed my ability to translate complex data into clear visuals, master confident delivery, and consistently drive measurable results with any audience.
